glyphs.reason: Legacy cluster preserved only in the inherited trace file; final named mark inputs come from pieces.json.

limitations: N513 and N47 share reproduction history; not independent original drawings.
N47 three/four are fused and excluded from its comparison regions.
Forty body entries retained from Study 1; e/f/x/y remain legacy. Named mark inputs and their direct/derived/retained status are in pieces.json.

production_impressions.method: Repeated impressions on the Letraset production sheets, each registered onto the round-5 trace by its own affine transform (absorbing the photograph's local perspective), re-registered twice onto their mean with the frame pinned to the round-5 trace, averaged on a 1/8 trace-unit grid; edge at one level per sheet between the mean's backing and ink; fitted with curvefit3.contour_to_curves4.
production_impressions.caveat: The impressions are one artwork printed many times: averaging lowers print and photographic noise; it is not independent confirmation of the design. Proportions and placement remain those of the round-5 trace.
